# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All snapshot fields use explicit unit suffixes: tan_mg_n_per_l, nitrite_mg_n_per_l, nitrate_mg_n_per_l, phosphate_mg_p_per_l, dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_c_per_l, estimated_tds_7_ion_mg_per_l, estimated_conductivity_us_cm — verified in snapshot.rs:16-28.
- Conversion constants (NO3_PER_N, NO2_PER_N, NH4_PER_N, NH3_PER_N, PO4_PER_P) are centralized in conversions.rs with molar-mass documentation. 7 unit tests verify reference values, all 5 round-trip conversions within 1e-12, and zero-stays-zero: all pass.
- GH/KH constants (CALCIUM_AS_CACO3_FACTOR, MAGNESIUM_AS_CACO3_FACTOR, MOLAR_MASS_CACO3_G_PER_MOL, etc.) are named and documented in water.rs:10-23. ESTIMATED_TDS_TO_CONDUCTIVITY_DIVISOR has a doc comment explaining the empirical freshwater approximation.
- TDS/conductivity labeled as estimates everywhere: overview.rs:132-134 renders 'Est. TDS (7-ion)' and 'Est. cond'; chemistry.rs:57-63 renders 'Est. TDS (7-ion)' and 'Est. conductivity (7-ion)'. Test overview_labels_tds_and_conductivity_as_estimates verifies and asserts !contains('7-ion TDS').
- Scope lines (ESTIMATED_TDS_SCOPE_LINES) document tracked 7 ions and omitted contributors on both overview and chemistry screens. Test estimated_tds_scope_lines_name_included_and_omitted_species verifies content.
- API backward compatibility: insert_legacy_chemistry_fields() backfills all 8 old field names in snapshot_response_json(), which is used consistently on /snapshot, /time/step, /load, and /scenarios/load. Test snapshot_response_keeps_legacy_chemistry_aliases verifies.
- API metadata: chemistry_field_semantics_json() explains each field's unit basis, estimated_tds_scope_json() lists tracked ions and omitted contributors, legacy_chemistry_aliases_json() maps old->new names. Test chemistry_response_explains_estimate_scope verifies.
- TUI client handles version-skewed servers: normalize_snapshot_object() in api_client.rs maps 8 legacy field names to canonical names. 3 tests verify: legacy-only parsing, canonical-takes-precedence, and /load nested payload compatibility.
- Threshold event summaries use explicit chemistry bases: 'Free ammonia (NH3-N) reached ... mg NH3-N/L' and 'Nitrite-N reached ... mg N/L' — verified in events.rs:24,33. Test threshold_event_summaries_use_explicit_chemistry_units passes.
- cargo test -p tank_api: 3 passed. cargo test -p tank_core conversions: 7 passed. cargo test -p tank_core --test events: 7 passed. cargo test -p tank_core --test concentration_helpers: 10 passed. cargo test -p tank_tui --lib: 7 passed (including the previously-failing rejects_invalid_integer_counts). cargo clippy -p tank_api -p tank_tui -p tank_core -- -D warnings: clean, no warnings.

## Findings and Gaps

- The tank_tui test rejects_invalid_integer_counts now passes (prior stages reported it as a pre-existing failure); this is an improvement, not a gap.
- No dedicated render test asserts the exact TUI text of the overview or chemistry screens end-to-end (only the estimate-label test and scope-lines test exist). This is a minor coverage gap but reasonable given the TUI is not a stable API surface.
- The overview screen's hardware panel inserts 3 scope lines, which may cause visual overflow on very small terminals. This is a known aesthetic tradeoff documented in prior review output.

## Follow-up and Amendments

None.
